svg.title: The reproduction state on the Pecos layout
svg.desc: Pecos combined with the SW2-905 reproduction state: a car on tray 27 in bay B7, every stall but P15 occupied, P24 disabled, and AGV 1 stopped on charger C14, 0.6 m from P15.

g.text: Occupancy from scenario_proposal/busy_garage_car_in_bay_7_agv_on_charger_14.yaml on the real Pecos geometry. The insert must take T27 out of B7 and

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: park it; P15 is the only stall without a tray, and AGV-1 on C14 physically overlaps it.
